title: Origin story: Gildenshield
description: Gildenshield was a shieldmaiden whose shield was gilded by a grateful city, and who discovered the gilding held: no blow ever pierced it. She became the defender of the free cities, standing in every breach, and her shield-line has never broken. She asks only that the cities remain worth defending.
